title: The Tennis Menace Two
overview: When her father dies after challenging a divine being called "The Tennis God" to a table tennis match, Kat finally gets the chance to prove to everyone that she's the best. All she has to do is beat The Tennis God. How hard can it be?

title: Third Love
overview: It's a story about some teen aged boy and girl of a University. A romantic story but in this story viewers will get a heavy sad and deep message. Which will make them realized a universal truth about transgender people and their feelings.

title: The Housemaid's Secret
overview: Millie Calloway takes a job keeping house for a woman she's never allowed to see — only to discover the truth behind the locked door that threatens to expose secrets far darker than her own.

title: Untitled Ocean's Prequel
overview: Follows Danny Ocean's parents, two masterminds, as they pull off an elaborate heist at the 1962 Monaco Grand Prix.

title: The Eight Saga:N.E.S.T.Project
overview: After a solar flare causes society's collapse, a new world emerges under the control of the N.E.S.T organisation, where the illusion of freedom masks a sinister reality.

title: Plátano Champion
overview: A summary of the Dominican Republic's undefeated championship run in the 2013 World Baseball Classic.

title: What Happened to Doris?
overview: In 1974 LA suburbs, a single mom faces violent attacks by an invisible entity. When no one believes her, she seeks help from paranormal investigators, sparking a notorious documented supernatural case.

title: S/H/V
overview: Four students, who make money by putting stolen school items online, are hired to steal a VHS tape from their Physical Education Teacher’s Office. However, things take a turn for the worse, when they find dozens of tapes, and being kids, they dare each other to partake in watching them.

At 8:38 PM, May wakes up in a room with no memory. With one lifeline call, she must uncover the truth, before it’s too late. But is the voice helping her… or hiding something darker? 8 minutes is all she has.

title: One Sweet Hour
overview: An ageing Elvis impersonator finally faces up to his demons as he travels through the Irish midlands with his long-lost brother, who has recently quit his life in a monastery.

title: UK Holiday
overview: A UK Holiday is not just a journey; it’s an adventure filled with love, laughter, and unforgettable memories. The story revolves around Aakash, a kind-hearted and adventurous young man, who invites his sister Rekha from the USA to visit the UK for a long-awaited family reunion. Rekha, excited to escape her routine, is thrilled to meet their mother, Subhadra, and sisters Priyanka and Deepika, who already reside in the UK. Aakash ensures this holiday becomes a truly special experience. Together, they explore London’s iconic landmarks like the London Eye and Tower Bridge. The journey takes them to the natural wonder of Durdle Door in Dorset and the charming town of Aldershot. Along the way, they share stories, laughter, and moments of deep connection. This feature film captures the essence of holidays—taking a break, reconnecting with loved ones, and creating memories that last a lifetime. UK Holiday is a celebration of family, adventure, and the joy of togetherness.

title: Summer's End
overview: Grace has spent the summer looking after her dad, who is still mourning over the loss of his wife who died when Grace was a child. When her unpredictable older brother Oscar brings his friends to stay with them, Grace is forced to confront her relationship with the past and her expectations of the future.

title: Convince Me
overview: When a heartbroken man is forced to convince the Devil to grant his wish, he must face the truth about himself or risk paying an eternal price.

title: Bunker Heights
overview: Citizens of a troubled city must navigate through an unforeseen crisis that threatens every walk of life.

title: Robbin' the Hood
overview: Two brothers are roped into a scheme to rob from the rich and give to the poor, only to find their victims are not who they think they are.

title: The Black Rock
overview: Summer, 1940. The Battle of Britain is lost. Operation Sea Lion is now in full effect. Germany invades the coast of Britain, only several fortresses are left standing in the defence against tyranny. Amongst the chaos, two enemy soldiers find themselves trapped in one such fortress together.

title: Crooked Miles
overview: Desperate people receive a mystical gift that grants wishes, collects souls, and creates monsters.

title: Funny Money: The Dane Cook Story
original_title: Funny Money: The Dane Cook Story
overview: At the height of his career, Dane Cook wasn't just selling out arenas; he was redefining what a stand-up comedian could be. Then, in a shocking betrayal, the person he trusted most stole millions of dollars, forever changing his life. FUNNY MONEY: THE DANECOOK STORY is a gripping documentary about fame, family, greed, and survival, revealing the extraordinary true story behind one of comedy's biggest icons.

title: Miller Night Football
overview: Chronicles comedian Dennis Miller's unlikely arrival in the "Monday Night Football" (MNF) broadcast booth in 2000, alongside veteran sportscaster Al Michaels and former NFL quarterback Dan Fouts. Intended to reinvigorate the iconic television franchise and attract a broader audience, Miller's addition, and his distinctly cerebral brand of humor, was met with both intrigue and skepticism across sports and television.

title: The new advocate
overview: An unspecified future: humanity has vanished from planet Earth. A printer, set to automatic mode, keeps reproducing a short story by Franz Kafka featuring Bucephalus, the horse of Alexander the Great. Will this final message from humankind reach the surviving forms of life? Or will it be nothing more than words lost to the wind?

title: Brothers in Blood: Black in Vietnam
original_title: Brothers in Blood: Black in Vietnam
overview: In the 1960s and early 1970s, Black Americans fought two wars, one in Vietnam and one at home for civil rights. As disproportionate numbers of Black men were drafted and sent to the front lines, the racism they faced in the United States followed them overseas. Through firsthand testimony, Brothers in Blood: Black in Vietnam examines discrimination within the military and the lasting physical, emotional, and social consequences veterans faced after returning home.

title: Fight for the Fantasy
overview: A divorcée goes on her first date in years and immediately tries to force a love connection over chicken wings.

title: Art of Destruction
overview: We follow the story of The Thinker bombing at the Cleveland Museum of Art, trying to solve the mystery behind it because no one was ever caught. By following this case, we unravel the whole landscape of Cleveland and the USA in the 60s/70s - student protests, social justice movements, anti-war movements, and radical militant groups. We give a context to the bombing, which is symbolic on so many levels - it's an art piece that randomly became a target for political violence that, by being left unrepaired, became a reminder of the complicated history of the 60s/70s. The Thinker is a silent witness to this fascinating decade, looking down from his pedestal, still thinking about our place in the world as humans.

title: Buzzkill
overview: A group of sorority sisters end up trapped with a murderer. Nora’s tipsy memories hold the clues to figuring out who is killing their friends, but she can only remember them when she’s drunk.

title: Between Silence and Truth
overview: In the wake of a devastating accident, a couple's crumbling relationship  faces a profound test as the wife's amnesia wipes away their painful history, leaving the husband torn between hidden grief and a delicate secret.

title: Beauty from Surrender
overview: Laurelyn tries to build her music career in Nashville after a painful breakup, while Jack tries to find his way back to her.

title: Blister on the Boy’s Body
overview: After his parents' divorce, 10 year old city boy Boy is sent to live with his grandfather in a rural valley. Soon, a painful blistering skin condition spreads across his body. To help him, his grandfather boils medicinal tree bark for a healing wash. This remedy not only cures his physical ailment, but the surrounding nature also soothes Boy's inner emotional wounds.

title: Isolation
overview: Isolation explores loneliness, grief, loss, and the struggles of mental health. All within a pursuit of understanding one's purpose. It's a coalescence of one's trauma and working through it while performing at a high level.

title: SHOWGIRLS - the Da Da Edit
overview: A lesbian rewrite of an already lesbian film. Rotoscoped with reverence.

title: Demoni Ferox: Night People Stole My Baby
original_title: Demoni Ferox: Night People Stole My Baby
overview: Surreal nightmares haunt a young couple until late one stormy night, when they are visited by the Night People.

title: Nimesh Patel: Buy The Dip
overview: In his first Netflix special, Nimesh Patel talks rebelling against his traditional parents and why you should never go viral in India.

title: REO: The Dangerous Peak
overview: A documentary following a young mountaineer, Yashwanth Naik, on an expedition to Mount Reo Purgyil in Himachal Pradesh.

title: La Main Armée Du Fascisme
overview: A film about police repression in France.

title: MONSTER
overview: An office worker is visited by a deadly monster. 2 minutes AI created short film.

title: My Found Footage
overview: The motto "put yourself in danger and film it" takes a filmmaker around the world.  He's hoping it's harder for anyone "dark-sided" to curse a moving target.

title: The Idiot Tapes
overview: Two idiotic teenagers mess around in their backyard late at night.

title: Mechamoefoe: Rise of Grogzilla
overview: A Cold Ones animated short by Studio Goblin.

title: The Magician
overview: Unlock a new fear you didn't think you had in you: spider-like magicians that kidnap babies and make terrible life-partners.

title: In Vivid Memory, Come Again
overview: On her 21st birthday, a heartbroken teenage girl revisits the bittersweet moments of her previous relationship before finally letting go of the past.

title: The Importance of Trans Elders
overview: Jack Gray and Kitty Cane Harry discuss their experiences as older transgender individuals and the struggles they faced growing up and accepting themselves in a world that believed their identities weren't valid.

title: Narrative Divine: Sunboy, Even Brighter
overview: Sunboy and Woofpal complete missions as always until someone unexpected comes along... even worse, she's mortal.

title: A Night in the Rain ft. The Stray
original_title: A Night in the Rain ft. The Stray
overview: On a quiet rainy night, a stray cat finds shelter as the rain transforms an ordinary moment into something quietly cinematic.

title: Caged
overview: Someone is caged.

title: Go Home Joe
overview: In need of help, your average Joe takes a little pill to test the bounds of change.

title: Ouroboros
overview: A talking puppet guides a disenchanted woman through the changing humours of her life.

title: We Are Nature
overview: Connor and Anesu immerse themselves in Scotland's landscapes in this portrait of belonging and resilience. Through personal stories and childhood memories, they explore the intersections of space, power, race, and the outdoors. 'We Are Nature' captures the spirit of those who, despite injustice, reclaim their connection with nature. It's an invitation to witness resilience and community strength, and to imagine a more equitable relationship between humans and the environment.

title: The Manager
overview: A workplace rumour drives a newly promoted worker crazy

title: Bullet Man
overview: A detective tracks down the last bullet in Tulsa.

title: Bus Stop
overview: At a quiet downtown bus shelter after midnight, a girl sits alone with her music until an unexpected encounter with a familiar face forces her to make a choice about where she's headed next.

title: Earl & Murial's Rural Burial
overview: Murl Imperial, still bloody from killing and burying his parents, is interrupted in his grief by an invasive couple arriving on his doorstep. Murl follows the couple through his home, anxiously anticipating the return of the phone, and the call, that started it all.

title: Sparks
overview: Two late-20s Londoners walk home from their first date and see the exact life they will have if they pursue the sparks between them.

title: Premature
overview: After an impulsive one-night stand leads to an unexpected pregnancy, two flatmates must confront who they are, and who they want to be, before the baby arrives.

title: The Com: Online, Sadistic and Deadly.
original_title: The Com: Online, Sadistic and Deadly.
overview: Parents are being warned of the dangers of ‘The Com’ or ‘764’, a sadistic online network that targets often vulnerable young people, destroying their lives. Sky's Adele Robinson reports using testimony from survivors, parents, law enforcement investigators and journalists, as they try to understand this new global grooming terror.

title: The Depths
overview: After a brother and sister achieve astral projection, the footage they capture reveals the malicious effects of their family trauma.

title: AUNT MAIR
overview: A monologue about coal mining and frilly hats.

title: Ethel
overview: Ethel Berkowitz only wants to have a quiet afternoon prepping for Halloween, but when she is interrupted by her unhinged neighbor she is forced into a tense exchange which promises to push them both to their limits.

title: Waterman's Heritage - Oysters in St. Mary's County
original_title: Waterman's Heritage - Oysters in St. Mary's County
overview: ‘Waterman's Heritage - Oysters in St. Mary's County’ is a documentary that tells the tale of the men and women who harvest oysters throughout the Chesapeake Bay, exploring their impact on bay restoration and how this seafood staple get's on our dinner tables.  The film follows four oyster businesses throughout the county, Bay River Fishing, Wild Willy's Seafood, Loose Stones Oyster Company and Double T Oyster Ranch, each representing a unique approach to oyster harvesting and farming practices. ‘Waterman's Heritage’ aims to educate viewers about the state of the industry and above all, make you hungry to visit restaurants and seafood markets in St. Mary's County.

title: Peculiar Green
overview: A middle-aged man with deity-like powers details the creation of his new world. A world characterized by a shade of green.

title: Cùil Lodair
overview: Set in the aftermath of the infamous Battle of Culloden, Cùil Lodair follows Eòin, a defeated Highland soldier navigating a shattered landscape.

title: CHASING RAHUL
overview: In modern-day Bangalore, Sama sets on to chase the old-school romance she grew up believing in, all while discovering the little beauties of Bangalore city.

title: RAT KING: OUROBOROS
overview: In a dystopian reality, 50% of human beings have microplastics inside their body. This results to a number of people experiencing hearing inner voices claiming to be the microplastics gaining sentience.  A young man (Ted) affected by this phenomenon tries to make amends with the microplastic inside of him.

title: TEENAGERS
overview: Six old friends gather at Megan’s house for a quiet reunion while her parents are away. What begins as a casual night of music, drinks, and nostalgia quickly becomes tense as old memories resurface and the group dynamic begins to fracture. As the night goes on, an unsettling feeling takes hold, turning the familiar setting into something increasingly dangerous.

title: Drop Dead
overview: A group of strangers board a freight elevator and find themselves trapped in an ever-worsening life-and-death predicament that ultimately reveals they are all linked together in a sinister, supernatural, or even biblical nightmare.

title: They're Here
overview: Edén Villa (pseudonym) and anonymous Minneapolis residents evade and resist the paramilitary occupation of their city, in a winter landscape where masked agents abduct children, residents travel in trunks, shackled prisoners are loaded onto airplanes within eyesight of vacationers, and bicyclists track the movements of an invading force.

title: Spiral
overview: While celebrating his engagement, Sean finds out that his future brother-in-law has an unnaturally large penis.

title: A Quiet Man
overview: 5 years after an outbreak that broke the world, Alan Garrick sets out to visit his wife's grave with the intention of ending his life there. Along the way he meets an unlikely companion in Max, an escaped, mute convict who, unbeknownst to Alan, killed his brother.

title: Bucking Fastard
overview: Two sisters, Jean and Joan Holbrooke, are so close to each other that they speak in unison, love the same man, and have the same dreams. They even make the same slip of tongue in unison. We cannot see the world as they see it, but we do see how the world reacts to them – through the courts and the press, through those that want to help and those who want to use them, through the eyes of beasts both tame and wild, and even through their own echoes in the core of the earth.

title: Hammer and Nail
overview: Ondřej Blažek, confronts the raw, untold emotions behind the fight. This UFC-inspired documentary takes you deep into the mind of a fighter, where each punch carries the weight of personal sacrifice, triumph, and inner demons. With high-octane energy and cinematic intensity, Coach Ondřej revisits pivotal moments from his career, reflecting on the emotional turmoil and adrenaline that fuel him. Watch as we recreate one of his most defining fights, immersing you in the brutal reality of what it means to fight, not just against your opponent—but against yourself.

title: Across Timing
overview: Rachel, Hadrian, Stormi, and Julian are teenagers dealing with their own insecurities, desires, and fears while finding solace in conversations with a friend who watches them from behind a camera. Between spontaneous confessions and heavy silences, each of them reveals fragments of who they are and who they wish to be. But some truths are hard to face, and not all stories follow the path we imagine.

title: Through the Lens
overview: Nestled along the Great Eastern Highway in regional Western Australia stands The Big Camera — a museum housed inside a building shaped like a giant camera. What many mistake for a novelty roadside attraction is, in fact, one of the most significant private photography collections in the Southern Hemisphere.  This short documentary explores the life and legacy of The Big Camera Museum of Photography and its founder, Charles “Chic” Wadley, whose lifelong passion for capturing and preserving photographic history has created a one-of-a-kind cultural landmark.  Through personal interviews, archival imagery, cinematic visuals, and historical context, the film uncovers how this extraordinary museum came to exist, why it remains vital to regional heritage, and what it tells us about photography’s power to document human experience.

title: You Fuckers Figure It Out: A Jason Molina Story
original_title: You Fuckers Figure It Out: A Jason Molina Story
overview: Conjure the spirit of indie-rock icon Jason Molina (1973-2013) with Ohio insiders who illuminate Truth about his coming of age on Lake Erie, escaping artless steel town indifference, and manifesting the legendary band, Songs: Ohia, as they celebrate contradictions that tether Jason’s raunchy humor, propensity to lie, refusal to interpret lyrics, and untimely death into a haunting legacy unconfined by the record vault.

title: Legend of the White Dragon
overview: Forced to hide in the shadows, fugitive hero Erik Reed must clear his name to reunite with his family. Standing in his way is a mysterious villain obsessed with destroying the White Dragon for good.

title: Amongst Men
overview: Relatives of Charles Byrne ‘The Irish Giant’ reckon with the legacy of a man both mythologised and misunderstood and the condition that links them still.

title: Don't Let Me Down
overview: When estranged friends Michael and Elizabeth reunite, Michael finds himself struggling to leave the past behind.

title: Peter
overview: Peter North became the most famous male adult film star in history, but before the fame he was Alden Brown, a young man from Halifax, Nova Scotia chasing Hollywood dreams. When mounting debts to organized crime pulled him into the adult film business, his life took an unexpected turn. For the first time ever, North shares his extraordinary story in his own words, alongside interviews with Jenna Jameson, Ginger Lynn, Christy Canyon and more who help reveal the man behind the legend.

title: Epitaph
overview: Newlywed Anna and her husband relocate to Alaska, but their blissful life takes a dark turn when a car crash causes Anna to develop selective amnesia. The incident triggers agoraphobia and haunting flashbacks.

title: Murder of An Angel
overview: After an unknowable entity goes missing, the other searches for them alone, while slowly reckoning with the secret buried within humanity.
